regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow and concentrated in Banks (H + HK), which ranks first but is crowded, mean-reverting, and unscorable — consistent with the detector's own verdict that momentum rank is an attention lens, not alpha. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control, but only four themes are eligible and no theme has an ETF proxy except the two bottom-ranked China tech names, so very few of the strong names can actually be graded.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) can close the leadership gap with Banks — the condition to retire this watch is Energy's score exceeding Banks' score and Banks losing eligibility to Energy while both remain above the trend gate.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the eligible set with the highest momentum score and have broad participation (breadth 0.769), so they are the prevailing narrative. However, the theme is crowded and mean-reverting by Hurst tag, durability is only 0.59, and it has no ETF proxy to grade against — so this is a direction-only lean expressed as a conditional, supported by rank and breadth, not a prediction of continued leadership.
evidence: breadth 0.769, highest among top-5 eligible names
theses.dissent: Being crowded and mean-reverting means the crowd has already arrived; a mean-reversion signature on the leading theme raises the risk that the marginal buyer is exhausted, especially with rotation breadth only 0.24 (narrow).

falsifier.text: Banks fail to make a new relative high versus Hang Seng within 20 trading days

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the challenger to Banks and the only strong eligible theme with a trend tag rather than mean-revert, suggesting greater internal coherence. It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.24, crowded=false) and has a solid durability_bar of 0.68, but it is also unscorable, so the lean is a conditional on trend continuation rather than a graded call.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.6, lower than Banks, and rotation is narrow (eligible frac 0.24) so the challenger may lack the broad participation needed to displace the leader.

falsifier.text: Energy lags Banks by more than 4% relative on a 30-day basis before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: This is the only scorable theme with an ETF proxy (3033.HK) among the bottom of the table, and it is ineligible with a negative score. The lean is a direction-only expression against continued participation, grounded in the theme's rank, negative score, and ineligibility — not in a forecast of further decline.
theses.dissent: In a narrow regime, deeply ranked and non-crowded themes can snap back sharply on any unscheduled surprise (macro_narrative unscheduled_share is 1.0), and the negative crowding_z means short interest is not stretched.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK outperforms Hang Seng by 5% in a single week before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
